# Tern

> Free, open-source Alt-Tab for Mac: a native window switcher that lets you hide the apps you don't need.

Tern is a menu bar app for macOS 13 or later (Apple silicon and Intel). Press Option-Tab (⌥⇥) to cycle open windows by recency, type to search, and hide an app or a single window from the switcher. MIT license, no account, no tracking. Not the Stencil Mac terminal also named Tern.
